### Promoted-but-unproposed change directory fails document validation and the pre-commit hook

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed during the shared-expense-tracker pilot on the e5dbe1f build. now <work-item-id> leaves openspec/changes/<change>/ with only origin.json; work-item render, documents validate, and hook pre-commit then fail with OPENSPEC_CHANGE_TREE_UNSAFE (no .openspec.yaml) and, after scaffolding metadata, MISSING_CHANGE_ARTIFACT (no proposal.md). The state cannot be committed with hooks on until propose runs. Candidate fixes: promotion scaffolds the minimum change artifacts, or validators recognise an origin-only directory as promoted-not-yet-proposed.

### now <text> surfaces the missing protected base as a raw error instead of the Fail-Grant challenge

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. The intent-level now facade returns PROPOSE_PROTECTED_BASE_UNAVAILABLE raw; only the propose command routes it through createProposeProtectedBaseFailGrantResult. Route the facade through the same handler.

### Protected-base Fail-Grant is the exit; a local-only base needs its own design (verdict: not a defect)

- Kind: improvement
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot; revised after reading the eight call sites. A local protected base would leave archive publication and maintainer attestation undefined, so it is a design change rather than an added grant choice. The engine refusing to plan against a base that does not exist, and converting that into a Fail-Grant asking a person to create it, is correct under R-000. The real gap was the now facade surfacing the raw error, which is fixed. Recommend closing.

### Planning worktree has no node_modules, so OpenSpec materialization fails after the investigation seals

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. After the investigation seals, propose --resume fails with OPENSPEC_INSTALLATION_INVALID because the engine-created planning worktree has no node_modules and the OpenSpec resolver only accepts a project-local install inside the worktree. Provision the worktree during materialization or resolve OpenSpec from the main checkout.

### Governed provider projection breaks on a planning worktree that contains node_modules

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. The governed projection counts ignored files against a 100k-entry budget, so a worktree with node_modules fails every provider job with GOVERNED_PROJECTION_FAILED, while OpenSpec needs node_modules in that worktree. Exclude ignored dependency trees from the budget or provision a minimal OpenSpec closure.

### job retry-request dead-ends for a failed provider attempt instead of pointing at the propose retry envelope

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. For a failed provider attempt, job retry-request returns EXECUTION_REPLACEMENT_GRANT_NOT_AVAILABLE even though retry-preview allowed it; the real retry path is the plan-review-retry envelope through propose --resume. Make the job surface perform or name that path.

### Intent verbs capture --help as an owner Source and inbox item

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed while recording pilot findings. later --help wrote a Source and an inbox Work Item whose text is "--help". Intent verbs should answer --help with usage and refuse flag-shaped positional text before writing to the ledger.

### Job inspection keeps replacement lineage visible after an accepted winner (verdict: not a defect)

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot; final verdict after two corrections: not an engine defect. A Job whose replacement Attempt won still reports the earlier failure under latestFailure with decision JOB_RESULT_ALREADY_ACCEPTED, and the execution-runtime contract pins that lineage view. Agents must read runtimeStatus and acceptedAttemptId first. Recommend closing this item without an engine change.

### Automatic provider retry schedule leaves the replacement attempt queued until the next propose resume

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. A dispatch-issued automatic retry schedule leaves the replacement attempt queued; retry-pump finds nothing due and only a propose --resume bound to the new invocation starts it. Run the replacement from the schedule or document the resume as the dispatcher.

### Reviewer output rejected twice for a challenges scope assessment without a scope finding, and the semantic repair pass repeats the mistake

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. Codex set scopeAssessment challenges with no missing-scope or missing-consumers finding; the validator rejects it as PROVIDER_NATIVE_OUTPUT_INVALID without a diagnostic, and the semantic repair pass repeated the same output. Downgrade the mismatch into a finding the author can disposition, and report the validation path.

### Strategy-change retry decision for a plan-review job has no executor and no grant path

- Kind: bug
- Stage: inbox

Agent-observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot. After two same-fingerprint PlanReview failures the decision becomes strategy-change, but propose refuses it, the job surface reports RETRY_MODE_MISMATCH, and no grant request exists to approve, so the change is stuck. Mirror the survey path that accepts a changed execution policy as the strategy change.
